cond_0001.intro:
The Information Security Compliance Analyst will report to the Sr Manager of Quality and will be part of the OpEx compliance team. The Analyst will support global activities as they relate to ISO27001, ISO9001 and ISO14001. You will be responsible for providing subject matter expertise in ISO27001 Information Security regarding compliance requirements. In addition, implementing, maintaining and improving the Information Security Management System at a corporate level for [Company name masked] facilities across [Location masked].
The Information Security Compliance Analyst will perform and lead complex compliance reviews, within the IT audits including network, internet, applications, telecommunications, security administration, and contingency planning. Assess risks, develops detail audit/compliance programs, execute audit/compliance programs steps, analyses result and effectively communicates results to senior management.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Manage and Support IT compliance activities for regional information security support of ISO27001 auditing, reporting and remediation where appropriate.
Coordinate and communicate IT compliance activities to align with Global IS leadership in support and improvement of ISO27001 management system.
Ensure regional IS compliance to IS security standards (ISO27001) requirements.
Plan and conduct complex IS and integrated audit/compliance projects, including preparation of an objective risk-based assessment and an effective audit/compliance approach.
Leads and/or participates on audit/compliance activities of various locations and departments for compliance with plans, policies and procedures.
Execute operational activities to support IS audit and compliance activities including technical validation processes.
Execute collection of evidence to support compliance status.
Provide and present reporting including monthly metric delivery.
Manage escalation and enforcement for unresolved noncompliance issues.
Manage and Support External Audit activities and reporting.
Work with Information Security staff to ensure tools and reporting mechanisms are satisfactorily meeting statutory objectives.
Support compliance and security validation of all 3rd party IT providers.
Maintain strong working relationships with internal and external support teams including Global, Regional and Country IS associates.
Work on special projects as required by management.
Stay abreast of changes within the IS compliance areas including business change requirements and regulatory changes from an international perspective.
Support and enforce Information Security Policy, Standards, and Guidelines for business operations and technology implementations.
Work as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on assigned projects and offers council regarding the intent of Compliance requirements.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related Science and Math discipline with an IS or Business emphasis.
5+ Years of experience with IS compliance projects (specifically ISO27001).
Understands key security concepts such as access management, vulnerability and patch management, security information event management, and encryption.
Strong understanding of TCP/IP and other network protocols.
Understanding of the basic audit best practices, standards and methodologies.
Must possess a valid passport and be legally allowed to leave and return to originating country.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to formulate detailed technical documentation.
ASQ Certified Engineer, Auditor or OE Managers.
Experience using SharePoint, MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Visio.

cond_0234.intro:
The Information Security Compliance Analyst will report to the Sr Manager of Quality and will be part of the OpEx compliance team. The Analyst will work with the team on global activities related to ISO27001, ISO9001 and ISO14001, supporting subject matter expertise in ISO27001 Information Security compliance requirements. This includes coordinating the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the Information Security Management System at a corporate level across [Location masked] facilities.
The role involves collaborating on complex compliance reviews within IT audits covering network, internet, applications, telecommunications, security administration, and contingency planning. Working alongside senior management and regional teams, the Analyst helps assess risks, develop audit/compliance programs, execute program steps, analyze results, and communicate findings.

Stay current on changes within IS compliance areas including business change requirements and regulatory changes from an international perspective.

The Analyst will support global activities as they relate to ISO27001, ISO9001 and ISO14001. You will be responsible for providing subject matter expertise in ISO27001 Information Security regarding compliance requirements. In addition, implementing, maintaining and improving the Information Security Management System at a corporate level for [Company name masked] facilities across [Location masked].
The Information Security Compliance Analyst will perform and lead complex compliance reviews, within the IT audits including network, internet, applications, telecommunications, security administration, and contingency planning. Assess risks, develops detail audit/compliance programs, execute audit/compliance programs steps, analyses result and effectively communicates results to senior management.
cond_0326.responsibilities:
Additional Responsibilities Include:
Manage and Support IT compliance activities for regional information security support of ISO27001 auditing, reporting and remediation where appropriate. Coordinate and communicate IT compliance activities to align with Global IS leadership in support and improvement of ISO27001 management system. Ensure regional IS compliance to IS security standards (ISO27001) requirements. Plan and conduct complex IS and integrated audit/compliance projects, including preparation of an objective risk-based assessment and an effective audit/compliance approach. Leads and/or participates on audit/compliance activities of various locations and departments for compliance with plans, policies and procedures. Execute operational activities to support IS audit and compliance activities including technical validation processes. Execute collection of evidence to support compliance status. Provide and present reporting including monthly metric delivery. Manage escalation and enforcement for unresolved noncompliance issues. Manage and Support External Audit activities and reporting. Work with Information Security staff to ensure tools and reporting mechanisms are satisfactorily meeting statutory objectives. Support compliance and security validation of all 3rd party IT providers. Maintain strong working relationships with internal and external support teams including Global, Regional and Country IS associates. Work on special projects as required by management. Stay abreast of changes within the IS compliance areas including business change requirements and regulatory changes from an international perspective. Support and enforce Information Security Policy, Standards, and Guidelines for business operations and technology implementations. Work as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on assigned projects and offers council regarding the intent of Compliance requirements.
cond_0326.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related Science and Math discipline with an IS or Business emphasis required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in IS compliance projects, specifically ISO27001.
Advanced knowledge of key security concepts such as access management, vulnerability and patch management, security information event management, and encryption.
Deep knowledge of TCP/IP and other network protocols.
Strong command of audit best practices, standards and methodologies.
Must possess a valid passport and be legally allowed to leave and return to originating country.
Preferred Requirements
Proven ability to formulate detailed technical documentation.
ASQ Certified Engineer, Auditor or OE Manager certification.
Expertise in SharePoint, MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Visio.

Assess risks, develop detailed audit/compliance programs, execute audit/compliance program steps, analyze results, and effectively communicate results to senior management.
Additional Responsibilities Include:
Manage and Support IT compliance activities for regional information security support of ISO27001 auditing, reporting and remediation where appropriate. Coordinate and communicate IT compliance activities to align with Global IS leadership in support and improvement of ISO27001 management system. Ensure regional IS compliance to IS security standards (ISO27001) requirements. Plan and conduct complex IS and integrated audit/compliance projects, including preparation of an objective risk-based assessment and an effective audit/compliance approach. Leads and/or participates on audit/compliance activities of various locations and departments for compliance with plans, policies and procedures. Execute operational activities to support IS audit and compliance activities including technical validation processes. Execute collection of evidence to support compliance status. Provide and present reporting including monthly metric delivery. Manage escalation and enforcement for unresolved noncompliance issues. Manage and Support External Audit activities and reporting. Work with Information Security staff to ensure tools and reporting mechanisms are satisfactorily meeting statutory objectives. Support compliance and security validation of all 3rd party IT providers. Maintain strong working relationships with internal and external support teams including Global, Regional and Country IS associates. Work on special projects as required by management. Stay abreast of changes within the IS compliance areas including business change requirements and regulatory changes from an international perspective. Support and enforce Information Security Policy, Standards, and Guidelines for business operations and technology implementations. Work as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on assigned projects and offers council regarding the intent of Compliance requirements.
cond_0365.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related Science and Math discipline with an IS or Business emphasis
5+ Years of experience with IS compliance projects (specifically ISO27001)
Understands key security concepts such as access management, vulnerability and patch management, security information event management, and encryption
Strong understanding of TCP/IP and other network protocols
Understanding of basic audit best practices, standards, and methodologies
Ability to formulate detailed technical documentation
Must possess a valid passport and be legally allowed to leave and return to originating country
Preferred Requirements
ASQ Certified Engineer, Auditor, or OE Managers
Experience using SharePoint, MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio
